player's discard on the bottom of their deck.
zh: 意外發現　當你打出這個角色時，你可以將一張卡從指定玩家的棄牌堆放到其牌庫底。

name: Marshmallow - Cranky Climber
en:
ICY BLAST Whenever this character quests,
each opponent can't ready more than 1 of their
characters at the start of their next turn.

name: Christopher Robin - Joining the Fun
en:
UNDERDOG If this is your first turn and you're
not the first player, you pay 1 ⬡ less to play this
character.
zh: 居於劣勢　若這是你的第一個回合且你不是先手玩家，你打出這個角色時少支付 1 ⬡。

name: Lumpy - Playful Heffalump
en:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
zh: 迴避（只有具迴避的角色能挑戰這個角色。）

name: Witches of Morva - Orddu, Orwen, and Orgoch
en:
QUITE A BARGAIN When you play this character,
you may return another chosen character of yours
to your hand. If you do, gain 1 lore.
zh: 划算的交易　當你打出這個角色時，你可以將你另一個指定角色移回手牌。若你這麼做，獲得 1 點傳說值。

name: HeiHei - Persistent Presence
en:
HE'S BACK! When this character is banished in a
challenge, return this card from your discard to
your hand.
zh: 他回來了！　當這個角色在挑戰中被消滅時，將這張卡從棄牌堆移回你的手牌。

name: Sven - Leaping Reindeer
en:
Rush (This character can challenge the turn
they're played.)
Challenger +3 (While challenging, this character
gets +3 ¤.)
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
zh:
突襲（這個角色在被打出的回合就能挑戰。）
挑戰者 +3（挑戰時，這個角色獲得 +3 ¤。）
迴避（只有具迴避的角色能挑戰這個角色。）

name: Do You Want to Build A Snowman?
en:
(A character with cost 3 or more can ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
Chosen opponent chooses YES! or NO!:
• YES! You gain 3 lore.
• NO! They choose a character of theirs and put that
card on the bottom of their deck.
zh:
（費用 3 或以上的角色可以橫置來免費詠唱這首歌。）
指定對手選擇「要！」或「不要！」：
• 要！　你獲得 3 點傳說值。
• 不要！　他們選擇其一個角色，並將該卡放到其牌庫底。

name: Come Out and Fight!
en:
Put all cards from under chosen character, item, or
location on the bottom of their player's deck in a
random order. Draw a card.
zh: 將指定角色、物品或地點下方所有卡以隨機順序放到其持有者的牌庫底。抽一張牌。

name: Swordplay
en:
Chosen character gains Challenger +3 this turn.
(They get +3 ¤ while challenging.)
zh: 指定角色本回合獲得挑戰者 +3。（他們挑戰時獲得 +3 ¤。）

name: Colors of the Wind
en:
(A character with cost 4 or more can ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
Each player reveals the top card of their deck. Draw
a card for each different ink type of cards revealed
this way.
zh:
（費用 4 或以上的角色可以橫置來免費詠唱這首歌。）
每位玩家展示其牌庫頂的卡。以此方式展示的卡每有一種不同的墨水類型，你就抽一張牌。

name: Mother's Necklace
en:
PRECIOUS GIFT At the end of your turn, if none of your
characters challenged this turn, chosen character of
yours gains Evasive until the start of your next turn.
(Only characters with Evasive can challenge them.)
zh: 珍貴的禮物　在你的回合結束時，若你本回合沒有角色挑戰過，你一個指定角色獲得迴避，直到你的下個回合開始。（只有具迴避的角色能挑戰他們。）

name: Mystical Inkcaster
en:
SPECIAL SUMMONS ⟳, 3 ⬡ — Play a character with
cost 5 or less for free. They gain Rush. At the end of
your turn, banish them. (They can challenge the turn
they're played.)
zh: 特殊召喚　⟳，3 ⬡ — 免費打出一個費用 5 或以下的角色。他們獲得突襲。在你的回合結束時，消滅他們。（他們在被打出的回合就能挑戰。）

name: Pot of Honey
en:
I'M STUCK! Banish this item — Chosen exerted
character can't ready at the start of their next turn.
zh: 我卡住了！　消滅這個物品 — 指定的橫置角色在其下個回合開始時不能準備。

name: The Frozen Vine - Monstrous Plant
en:
PERSISTENT PROBLEM When this location is banished, if there was an
exerted character here, return this card from your discard to your hand.
zh: 揮之不去的問題　當這個地點被消滅時，若這裡有橫置的角色，將這張卡從棄牌堆移回你的手牌。

name: Mulan - Resourceful Recruit
en:
RIGOROUS TRAINING Whenever this character quests,
gain lore equal to her ¤, to a maximum of 6 lore.
zh: 嚴格訓練　每當這個角色探險時，獲得等同她 ¤ 的傳說值，最多 6 點傳說值。

name: Stitch - Naughty Experiment

I DARE YOU! ⟳ — Chosen opposing character

(They can't quest and must challenge if able.)

name: Big Mama - Clever and Calming

Ward (Opponents can't choose this character
except to challenge.)

看這個！　每當這個角色探險時，選擇一項：

Shift 5 ⬡ (You may pay 5 ⬡ to play this on top of one

變身 5 ⬡（你可以支付 5 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Tod 的角色上。）

draw a card for each card that was under them.

給予的精神　每當你使用一個角色的增幅能力時，你可以將你牌庫頂的卡牌面朝下放到他們下方。

zh:
（費用 4 或以上的角色可以橫置來免費詠唱這首歌。）

challenge this character.)
zh: 迴避（只有具迴避的角色能挑戰這個角色。）

name: Goofy - Marley's Clumsy Spirit
en:
PREPARE YOURSELF When you play this character,
you may ready chosen character. If you do, they
can't quest for the rest of this turn.
zh: 做好準備　當你打出這個角色時，你可以準備指定角色。若你這麼做，他們本回合剩餘時間內不能探險。

name: Goofy - Klutzy Skier
en:
YAAAAAAA-HOO-HOO-HOO-HOOEY ⟳, Banish this
character — Banish chosen character.
zh: 呀啊——呼——呼——呼——伊　⟳，消滅這個角色 — 消滅指定角色。

name: Olaf - Snowman of Action
en:
ABOUT TIME! For each action card in your
discard, you pay 1 ⬡ less to play this character.
CHAOTIC COLLISION When you play this
character, each opponent loses 2 lore.
zh:
是時候了！　你棄牌堆每有一張行動卡，你打出這個角色時就少支付 1 ⬡。
混亂碰撞　當你打出這個角色時，每位對手失去 2 點傳說值。

name: Elsa - Ice Artisan
en:
Shift 4 ⬡ (You may pay 4 ⬡ to play this on top of one of
your characters named Elsa.)
ENDLESS WINTER When you play this character and
whenever you play a location, you may exert chosen
character with 3 ¤ or less.
DISTANT CALL While this character is at a location, she
gets +3 ◊.
zh:
變身 4 ⬡（你可以支付 4 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Elsa 的角色上。）
無盡寒冬　當你打出這個角色以及每當你打出一個地點時，你可以橫置一個 3 ¤ 或以下的指定角色。
遠方的呼喚　當這個角色在地點時，她獲得 +3 ◊。

name: Scrooge McDuck - Ebenezer Scrooge
en:
PAYMENT DUE Whenever this character quests,
each opponent loses 1 lore. Draw a card for each 1
lore lost this way.
FORECLOSURE At the end of your turn, if an
opponent has 0 lore, you gain 1 lore.
zh:
欠款到期　每當這個角色探險時，每位對手失去 1 點傳說值。以此方式每失去 1 點傳說值就抽一張牌。
取消贖回權　在你的回合結束時，若有對手為 0 點傳說值，你獲得 1 點傳說值。

name: Elsa - Concerned Sister
en:
CLEAR THE WAY When you play this character,
you pay 2 ⬡ less for the next location you play
this turn.
zh: 清出道路　當你打出這個角色時，你本回合打出的下一個地點少支付 2 ⬡。

name: Willie the Giant - Ghost of Christmas Present
en:
Boost 3 ⬡ (Once during your turn, you may pay
3 ⬡ to put the top card of your deck facedown
under this character.)
THE FOOD OF GENEROSITY This character can't
quest or challenge unless you put a card under
him this turn.
zh:
增幅 3 ⬡（你回合中一次，你可以支付 3 ⬡ 將你牌庫頂的卡牌面朝下放到這個角色下方。）
慷慨的食物　除非你本回合把一張卡放到他下方，否則這個角色不能探險或挑戰。

name: Nani's Payback
en:
Each opponent loses lore equal to the damage on
chosen character of yours, to a maximum of 4 lore
each. Draw a card.
zh: 每位對手失去等同你一個指定角色身上傷害的傳說值，每人最多 4 點傳說值。抽一張牌。

name: Force of a Great Typhoon
en:
(A character with cost 2 or more can ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
Chosen character gets +5 ¤ this turn.
zh:
（費用 2 或以上的角色可以橫置來免費詠唱這首歌。）
指定角色本回合獲得 +5 ¤。

name: Marching Off to Battle
en:
(A character with cost 4 or more can ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
If a character was banished this turn, draw 2 cards.
zh:
（費用 4 或以上的角色可以橫置來免費詠唱這首歌。）
若本回合有角色被消滅，抽兩張牌。

name: The Cold Never Bothered Me
en:
(A character with cost 3 or more can ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
Look at the top 4 cards of your deck. You may reveal
a location card and put it into your hand. Put the
rest into your discard. You pay 3 ⬡ less for the next
location you play this turn.
zh:
（費用 3 或以上的角色可以橫置來免費詠唱這首歌。）
查看你牌庫頂 4 張卡。你可以展示一張地點卡並加入手牌。將其餘的放入你的棄牌堆。你本回合打出的下一個地點少支付 3 ⬡。

name: Grab Your Bow
en:
(A character with cost 5 or more can ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
Banish up to 2 chosen characters with 2 ¤ or less.
zh:
（費用 5 或以上的角色可以橫置來免費詠唱這首歌。）
消滅至多 2 個 2 ¤ 或以下的指定角色。

name: Lonely Grave
en:
HAUNTING PRESENCE ⟳, Banish chosen character of
yours — Put the top card of your deck facedown under
one of your characters or locations with Boost.
zh: 陰魂不散　⟳，消滅你一個指定角色 — 將你牌庫頂的卡牌面朝下放到你一個具增幅的角色或地點下方。

name: Kristoff's Lute
en:
MOMENT OF INSPIRATION ⟳, 2 ⬡ — Reveal the top
card of your deck. You may play it as if it were in your
hand. Otherwise, put it in your discard.
zh: 靈感時刻　⟳，2 ⬡ — 展示你牌庫頂的卡。你可以視同它在你手牌中般打出它；否則，將它放入你的棄牌堆。

name: Scrooge's Counting House - Ebenezer's Office
en:
Boost 2 ⬡ (Once during your turn, you may pay 2 ⬡ to put the top card of your
deck facedown under this location.)
GOOD BUSINESS This location gets +1 ⛉ and +1 ◊ for each card under it.
zh:
增幅 2 ⬡（你回合中一次，你可以支付 2 ⬡ 將你牌庫頂的卡牌面朝下放到這個地點下方。）
好生意　這個地點下方每有一張卡，它就獲得 +1 ⛉ 和 +1 ◊。

name: Graveyard of Christmas Future - Lonely Resting Place
en:
NEW ARRIVAL Whenever you move a character here, put the top card of your deck
under this location facedown.
ANOTHER CHANCE At the start of your turn, you may put all cards from under this
location into your hand. If you do, banish this location.
zh:
新的到來　每當你把一個角色移動到這裡時，將你牌庫頂的卡牌面朝下放到這個地點下方。
再一次機會　在你的回合開始時，你可以將這個地點下方所有卡加入你的手牌。若你這麼做，消滅這個地點。

name: Beast's Castle - Winter Gardens
en:
SNOWBALL STANDOFF Whenever a character here challenges another
character, gain 1 lore.
zh: 雪球對峙　每當有角色在這裡挑戰另一個角色時，獲得 1 點傳說值。

name: Roo - Little Helper
en:
HOPPING IN ⟳ — Put this character facedown
under one of your characters or locations
with Boost.
zh: 跳進來　⟳ — 將這個角色牌面朝下放到你一個具增幅的角色或地點下方。

name: Kanga - Peaceful Gatherer
en:
Boost 2 ⬡ (Once during your turn, you may pay
2 ⬡ to put the top card of your deck facedown
under this character.)
EXTRA HELP While there's a card under this
character, she gets +1 ◊.
zh:
增幅 2 ⬡（你回合中一次，你可以支付 2 ⬡ 將你牌庫頂的卡牌面朝下放到這個角色下方。）
額外幫助　當這個角色下方有卡時，她獲得 +1 ◊。

name: Minnie Mouse - Tiny Tim's Mother
en:
Support (Whenever this character quests, you may
add their ¤ to another chosen character's ¤
this turn.)
zh: 支援（每當這個角色探險時，你可以在本回合把其 ¤ 加到另一個指定角色的 ¤ 上。）

name: Sina - Vigilant Parent
en:
Alert (This character can challenge as if they had
Evasive.)
zh: 警戒（這個角色可以視同具迴避般挑戰。）

name: Honker Muddlefoot - Timid Genius
en:
BE CAREFUL! Your characters named Darkwing
Duck gain Resist +1. (Damage dealt to them is
reduced by 1.)
zh: 小心！　你名為 Darkwing Duck 的角色獲得抵抗 +1。（對他們造成的傷害減少 1。）

name: Darkwing Duck - Drake Mallard
en:
Ward (Opponents can't choose this character
except to challenge.)
zh: 守護（對手除了挑戰外不能選擇這個角色。）

name: Jiminy Cricket - Ghost of Christmas Past
en:
Boost 2 ⬡ (Once during your turn, you may pay 2 ⬡
to put the top card of your deck facedown under this
character.)
LOOK INTO YOUR PAST Whenever you put a card
under this character, you may put a card from your
discard into your inkwell facedown and exerted.
zh:
增幅 2 ⬡（你回合中一次，你可以支付 2 ⬡ 將你牌庫頂的卡牌面朝下放到這個角色下方。）
回顧你的過去　每當你把一張卡放到這個角色下方時，你可以將一張卡從棄牌堆牌面朝下並橫置放入你的墨水池。

name: Piglet - Cocoa Maker
en:
Shift 3 ⬡ (You may pay 3 ⬡ to play this on top of
one of your characters named Piglet.)
SPECIAL RECIPE At the end of your turn, remove
up to 2 damage from each of your characters.
zh:
變身 3 ⬡（你可以支付 3 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Piglet 的角色上。）
特殊食譜　在你的回合結束時，從你每個角色身上移除至多 2 點傷害。

name: Gramma Tala - Connected to Nature
en:
ANCESTORS' GIFT For each card in your inkwell,
you pay 1 ⬡ less to play this character.
zh: 先祖的恩賜　你墨水池每有一張卡，你打出這個角色時就少支付 1 ⬡。

name: Gosalyn Mallard - Curious Child
en:
KEEN GEAR When you play this character, look at
the top 4 cards of your deck. You may reveal an
item card and put it into your hand. Put the rest
on the bottom of your deck in any order.
zh: 敏銳裝備　當你打出這個角色時，查看你牌庫頂 4 張卡。你可以展示一張物品卡並加入手牌。將其餘的以任意順序放到你牌庫底。

name: Darkwing Duck - Dashing Gadgeteer
en:
MODERN MARVEL Whenever this character quests,
you may put an item card from your discard on the
bottom of your deck. If you do, you may play an item
with cost 5 or less from your discard for free.
zh: 現代奇蹟　每當這個角色探險時，你可以將一張物品卡從棄牌堆放到你牌庫底。若你這麼做，你可以從你的棄牌堆免費打出一個費用 5 或以下的物品。

name: Winnie the Pooh - Hungry Bear
en:
LOOKING FOR A MORSEL When you play this
character, you may return an item card from your
discard to your hand.
zh: 找點吃的　當你打出這個角色時，你可以將一張物品卡從棄牌堆移回你的手牌。

name: Scrooge McDuck - Reformed Ebenezer
en:
Shift 4 ⬡ (You may pay 4 ⬡ to play this on top of one
of your characters named Scrooge McDuck.)
SPREADING JOY When you play this character, you
may put a card from the top of your deck facedown
under each of your other characters. If you do, those
characters gain Ward until the start of your next turn.
(Opponents can't choose them except to challenge.)
zh:
變身 4 ⬡（你可以支付 4 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Scrooge McDuck 的角色上。）
散播歡樂　當你打出這個角色時，你可以將你牌庫頂的卡牌面朝下放到你每個其他角色下方。若你這麼做，那些角色獲得守護，直到你的下個回合開始。（對手除了挑戰外不能選擇他們。）

name: Splatter Phoenix - Rejected Artist
en:
UNDERDOG If this is your first turn and you're
not the first player, you pay 1 ⬡ less to play this
character.
Ward (Opponents can't choose this character
except to challenge.)
zh:
居於劣勢　若這是你的第一個回合且你不是先手玩家，你打出這個角色時少支付 1 ⬡。
守護（對手除了挑戰外不能選擇這個角色。）

name: Pete - Ghost of Christmas Future
en:
Boost 1 ⬡ (Once during your turn, you may pay 1 ⬡ to put
the top card of your deck facedown under this character.)
FOREBODING GLANCE Whenever this character quests, look
at a number of cards from the top of your deck equal to the
number of cards under him. Put one into your hand and put
the rest on the bottom of your deck in any order.
zh:
增幅 1 ⬡（你回合中一次，你可以支付 1 ⬡ 將你牌庫頂的卡牌面朝下放到這個角色下方。）
不祥一瞥　每當這個角色探險時，依他下方的卡數量查看你牌庫頂對應數量的卡。將一張加入手牌，將其餘的以任意順序放到你牌庫底。

name: Moana - Curious Explorer
en:
ANCESTRAL LEGACY You can ink cards from
your discard.
zh: 先祖傳承　你可以從你的棄牌堆將卡放入墨水池。

name: Tamatoa - Seeker of Shine
en:
Boost 2 ⬡ (Once during your turn, you may pay 2 ⬡ to put
the top card of your deck facedown under this character.)
Ward (Opponents can't choose this character except to
challenge.)
ANYTHING THAT GLITTERS Whenever you put a card under
one of your characters or locations, this character gets +1 ◊
this turn.
zh:
增幅 2 ⬡（你回合中一次，你可以支付 2 ⬡ 將你牌庫頂的卡牌面朝下放到這個角色下方。）
守護（對手除了挑戰外不能選擇這個角色。）
任何閃亮之物　每當你把一張卡放到你一個角色或地點下方時，這個角色本回合獲得 +1 ◊。

name: Morty Fieldmouse - Tiny Tim
en:
HOLIDAY SPIRIT Once during your turn,
whenever you put a card under one of your
other characters, put the top card of your deck
facedown under this character.
HOLIDAY CHEER This character gets +1 ◊ for
each card under him.
zh:
節慶精神　你回合中一次，每當你把一張卡放到你另一個角色下方時，將你牌庫頂的卡牌面朝下放到這個角色下方。
節慶歡樂　他下方每有一張卡，這個角色就獲得 +1 ◊。

name: Belle - Snowfield Strategist
en:
WINTER STOCKPILE Whenever one of your
characters is banished, you may put that card
from your discard into your inkwell facedown
and exerted.
zh: 寒冬儲備　每當你一個角色被消滅時，你可以將該卡從棄牌堆牌面朝下並橫置放入你的墨水池。

name: Mickey Mouse - Bob Cratchit
en:
HARD WORK Whenever this character quests, put
the top card of your deck facedown under him.
A GIVING HEART When this character is banished
in a challenge, you may put all cards that were
under him under another chosen character or
location of yours.
zh:
努力工作　每當這個角色探險時，將你牌庫頂的卡牌面朝下放到他下方。
慷慨之心　當這個角色在挑戰中被消滅時，你可以將他下方所有卡放到你另一個指定角色或地點下方。

name: Scrooge McDuck - Miserly Ebenezer
en:
BAH, HUMBUG During your turn, whenever a
card is put into your inkwell, chosen character
gets -1 ¤ this turn.
zh: 呸，胡扯　在你的回合中，每當有卡被放入你的墨水池時，指定角色本回合獲得 -1 ¤。

name: Chief Tui - Weaving a Tale
en:
AND THEN... Once during your turn, whenever a card
is put into your inkwell, look at the top card of your
deck. You may put it on either the top or the bottom of
your deck.
zh: 然後呢…　你回合中一次，每當有卡被放入你的墨水池時，查看你牌庫頂的卡。你可以將它放到你牌庫頂或牌庫底。

name: Visiting Christmas Past
en:
Put any number of cards from under your characters
and locations into your inkwell facedown and exerted.
zh: 將你角色和地點下方任意數量的卡牌面朝下並橫置放入你的墨水池。

name: Let It Go
en:
(A character with cost 5 or more can ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
Put chosen character into their player's inkwell
facedown and exerted.
zh:
（費用 5 或以上的角色可以橫置來免費詠唱這首歌。）
將指定角色牌面朝下並橫置放入其持有者的墨水池。

name: Distract
en: Chosen character gets -2 ¤ this turn. Draw a card.
zh: 指定角色本回合獲得 -2 ¤。抽一張牌。

name: Wipe Out!
en:
Put chosen character with Bodyguard or item into their
player's inkwell facedown and exerted.
zh: 將指定的具護衛角色或物品牌面朝下並橫置放入其持有者的墨水池。

name: Blue Smoke
en:
THEATRICAL ENTRANCE If you have a character named
Darkwing Duck in play, you pay 1 ⬡ less to play this item.
CLOUD OF MYSTERY ⟳, 1 ⬡, Banish this item — Chosen
character gains Ward until the start of your next turn.
(Opponents can't choose them except to challenge.)
zh:
戲劇性登場　若你有一個名為 Darkwing Duck 的角色在場，你打出這個物品時少支付 1 ⬡。
神秘之雲　⟳，1 ⬡，消滅這個物品 — 指定角色獲得守護，直到你的下個回合開始。（對手除了挑戰外不能選擇他們。）

name: Tiny Tim's Crutch
en:
AT YOUR SIDE ⟳ — Chosen character gains Support
this turn. (Whenever they quest, you may add their ¤
to another chosen character's ¤ this turn.)
zh: 在你身邊　⟳ — 指定角色本回合獲得支援。（每當他們探險時，你可以在本回合把其 ¤ 加到另一個指定角色的 ¤ 上。）

name: Darkwing's Chair Set
en:
SECRET ENTRANCE When you play this item, you may put the
top card of your deck into your inkwell facedown and exerted.
SUDDEN SPIN ⟳, Banish this item — Remove up to 2 damage
from chosen character. If a character named Darkwing Duck
is chosen, remove up to 4 damage instead.
zh:
秘密入口　當你打出這個物品時，你可以將你牌庫頂的卡牌面朝下並橫置放入你的墨水池。
突然旋轉　⟳，消滅這個物品 — 從指定角色身上移除至多 2 點傷害。若選擇的是名為 Darkwing Duck 的角色，改為移除至多 4 點傷害。

name: Darkwing's Gas Device
en:
BLINDING CLOUD ⟳, 1 ⬡ — Chosen character gets -1 ¤
this turn. If you have a character named Darkwing Duck
in play, chosen character gets -2 ¤ this turn instead.
zh: 致盲之雲　⟳，1 ⬡ — 指定角色本回合獲得 -1 ¤。若你有一個名為 Darkwing Duck 的角色在場，改為指定角色本回合獲得 -2 ¤。

name: Hidden Trap
en:
ALMOST READY This item enters play exerted.
SNAP! ⟳, Banish this item — Choose one:
• Banish chosen item.
• Chosen opposing character gets -2 ¤ this turn.
zh:
快好了　這個物品橫置進場。
啪！　⟳，消滅這個物品 — 選擇一項：
• 消滅指定的物品。
• 指定的對方角色本回合獲得 -2 ¤。

name: Rapunzel - Ethereal Protector
en:
Boost 2 ⬡ (Once during your turn, you may pay 2 ⬡
to put the top card of your deck facedown under this
character.)
CLONK! Whenever this character quests, if there's
a card under her, chosen opposing character can't
challenge until the start of your next turn.
zh:
增幅 2 ⬡（你回合中一次，你可以支付 2 ⬡ 將你牌庫頂的卡牌面朝下放到這個角色下方。）
鏗！　每當這個角色探險時，若她下方有卡，指定的對方角色在你的下個回合開始前不能挑戰。

name: Launchpad - Hideout Defender
en:
STAND GUARD Your locations gain Resist +1.
(Damage dealt to them is reduced by 1.)
zh: 站崗　你的地點獲得抵抗 +1。（對它們造成的傷害減少 1。）

name: Li Shang - Solemn Son
en:
Challenger +2 (While challenging, this character
gets +2 ¤.)
zh: 挑戰者 +2（挑戰時，這個角色獲得 +2 ¤。）

name: Gantu - Hamsterviel's Accomplice
en:
EASY TARGET When you play this character,
choose and discard a card.
zh: 容易的目標　當你打出這個角色時，選擇並棄掉一張卡。

name: Launchpad - Trusty Sidekick
en:
WHAT DID YOU NEED? ⟳ — Draw a card. Then,
choose and discard a card unless you have a
character named Darkwing Duck in play.
zh: 你需要什麼？　⟳ — 抽一張牌。然後，除非你有一個名為 Darkwing Duck 的角色在場，否則選擇並棄掉一張卡。

name: Donald Duck - Along for the Ride
en:
COMIN' THROUGH! When you play this character,
you may banish chosen item.
zh: 借過！　當你打出這個角色時，你可以消滅指定的物品。

name: Chief - Seasoned Tracker
en:
GOOD RIDDANCE ⟳ — If an opposing character
was banished in a challenge this turn,
draw a card.
zh: 除之後快　⟳ — 若本回合有對方角色在挑戰中被消滅，抽一張牌。

name: Amos Slade - Tenacious Tracker
en:
Alert (This character can challenge as if they had
Evasive.)
zh: 警戒（這個角色可以視同具迴避般挑戰。）

name: McHorn - Ice-Cold Officer
en:
Bodyguard (This character may enter play exerted.
An opposing character who challenges one of
your characters must choose one with Bodyguard
if able.)
zh: 護衛（這個角色可以橫置進場。挑戰你角色的對方角色，若有能力必須選擇具護衛的角色。）

name: Duke Weaselton - Surly Crook
en:
APPREHENDED When this character is banished,
you may play a character with cost 2 or less
for free.
zh: 被逮捕　當這個角色被消滅時，你可以免費打出一個費用 2 或以下的角色。

name: Li Shang - Valiant Leader
en:
Shift 4 ⬡ (You may pay 4 ⬡ to play this on top of
one of your characters named Li Shang.)
zh: 變身 4 ⬡（你可以支付 4 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Li Shang 的角色上。）

name: Nani - No Worries
en:
TAKE IT EASY While this character has no
damage, she gets +1 ◊.
zh: 放輕鬆　當這個角色沒有傷害時，她獲得 +1 ◊。

name: Stitch - High Badness Level
en:
AMPED UP While you have a character named
Lilo in play, this character gains Challenger +3.
(They get +3 ¤ while challenging.)
zh: 火力全開　當你有一個名為 Lilo 的角色在場時，這個角色獲得挑戰者 +3。（他們挑戰時獲得 +3 ¤。）

name: Dr. Hamsterviel - Infamous Scientist
en:
CONTROLLED VARIABLES For each Alien character
card in your discard, you pay 1 ⬡ less to play this
character.
AWESTRUCK When you play this character,
chosen opposing character can't challenge during
their next turn.
zh:
受控變數　你棄牌堆每有一張 Alien 角色卡，你打出這個角色時就少支付 1 ⬡。
驚嘆　當你打出這個角色時，指定的對方角色在其下個回合不能挑戰。

name: Angela - Night Warrior
en:
SHADOW POWER When you play this character,
you may give chosen character Challenger +2 and
Resist +2 until the start of your next turn. (They get
+2 ¤ while challenging. Damage dealt to them is
reduced by 2.)
ETERNAL NIGHT Your Gargoyle characters lose the
Stone by Day ability.
zh:
暗影之力　當你打出這個角色時，你可以給予指定角色挑戰者 +2 和抵抗 +2，直到你的下個回合開始。（他們挑戰時獲得 +2 ¤。對他們造成的傷害減少 2。）
永恆黑夜　你的石像鬼角色失去白日化石能力。

name: Darkwing Duck - Darkwarrior
en:
Challenger +2 (While challenging, this character
gets +2 ¤.)
INSTA-ARMOR During your turn, whenever an
item is banished, this character gains Resist +1
until the start of your next turn. (Damage dealt to
them is reduced by 1.)
zh:
挑戰者 +2（挑戰時，這個角色獲得 +2 ¤。）
即時裝甲　在你的回合中，每當有物品被消滅時，這個角色獲得抵抗 +1，直到你的下個回合開始。（對他們造成的傷害減少 1。）

name: Gigi - Best in Snow
en:
Alert (This character can challenge as if they
had Evasive.)
SO PRETTY While this character has no damage,
she gets +2 ¤.
zh:
警戒（這個角色可以視同具迴避般挑戰。）
好漂亮　當這個角色沒有傷害時，她獲得 +2 ¤。

name: Angel - Experiment 624
en:
UNTOUCHABLE While you have no cards in your
hand, this character gains Resist +2. (Damage
dealt to them is reduced by 2.)
GOOD AIM Once during your turn, you may
choose and discard a card to deal 2 damage to
chosen character.
zh:
無法觸及　當你手上沒有卡時，這個角色獲得抵抗 +2。（對他們造成的傷害減少 2。）
精準瞄準　你回合中一次，你可以選擇並棄掉一張卡，來對指定角色造成 2 點傷害。

name: Darkwing Duck - Cool Under Pressure
en:
Shift 5 ⬡ (You may pay 5 ⬡ to play this on top of one
of your characters named Darkwing Duck.)
TAKE THAT! During your turn, whenever an item is
banished, you may pay 1 ⬡ to deal 2 damage to chosen
character.
EVILDOERS BEWARE! This character can challenge ready
Villain characters.
zh:
變身 5 ⬡（你可以支付 5 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Darkwing Duck 的角色上。）
接招！　在你的回合中，每當有物品被消滅時，你可以支付 1 ⬡ 對指定角色造成 2 點傷害。
惡徒當心！　這個角色可以挑戰已準備的反派角色。

name: John Smith - Undaunted Protector
en:
Bodyguard (This character may enter play
exerted. An opposing character who challenges
one of your characters must choose one with
Bodyguard if able.)
DO YOUR WORST Opponents must choose this
character for actions and abilities if able.
zh:
護衛（這個角色可以橫置進場。挑戰你角色的對方角色，若有能力必須選擇具護衛的角色。）
放馬過來　對手若有能力，必須為行動和能力選擇這個角色。

name: Judy Hopps - Snowball Patrol
en:
UNDERDOG If this is your first turn and you're
not the first player, you pay 1 ⬡ less to play this
character.
Resist +1 (Damage dealt to this character is
reduced by 1.)
zh:
居於劣勢　若這是你的第一個回合且你不是先手玩家，你打出這個角色時少支付 1 ⬡。
抵抗 +1（這個角色受到的傷害減少 1。）

name: Lilo - Bundled Up
en:
EXTRA LAYERS During each opponent's turn, the
first time this character would take damage, she
takes no damage instead.
zh: 多穿幾層　在每位對手的回合中，這個角色第一次將受到傷害時，改為不受傷害。

name: Keep the Ancient Ways
en:
(A character with cost 2 or more can ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
Opponents can't play actions or items until the start of
your next turn.
zh:
（費用 2 或以上的角色可以橫置來免費詠唱這首歌。）
對手在你的下個回合開始前不能打出行動或物品。

name: The Terror That Flaps in the Night
en:
Deal 2 damage to chosen opposing character. If you
have a character named Darkwing Duck in play, deal 3
damage instead.
zh: 對指定的對方角色造成 2 點傷害。若你有一個名為 Darkwing Duck 的角色在場，改為造成 3 點傷害。

name: Let's Get Dangerous
en:
(A character with cost 4 or more can ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
Each player shuffles their deck and then reveals the
top card. Each player who reveals a character card
may play that character for free. Otherwise, put the
revealed cards on the bottom of their player's deck.
zh:
（費用 4 或以上的角色可以橫置來免費詠唱這首歌。）
每位玩家洗其牌庫，然後展示牌庫頂的卡。每位展示出角色卡的玩家可以免費打出該角色；否則，將展示出的卡放到其牌庫底。

name: Winterspell
en:
Chosen location of yours can't be challenged until the
start of your next turn. Draw a card.
zh: 你一個指定地點在你的下個回合開始前不能被挑戰。抽一張牌。

name: Nearly Indestructible
en:
Chosen character of yours gains Resist +2 until the
start of your next turn. (Damage dealt to them is
reduced by 2.)
zh: 你一個指定角色獲得抵抗 +2，直到你的下個回合開始。（對他們造成的傷害減少 2。）

name: Infra-Pink Ultra Scan Specs
en:
DETECTING EVIDENCE When you play this item, draw a
card, then choose and discard a card.
FOLLOW THE CLUES Banish this item — Chosen
character gains Alert this turn. (They can challenge as
if they had Evasive.)
zh:
偵測證據　當你打出這個物品時，抽一張牌，然後選擇並棄掉一張卡。
追查線索　消滅這個物品 — 指定角色本回合獲得警戒。（他們可以視同具迴避般挑戰。）

name: The Thunderquack
en:
VIGILANTE JUSTICE All opposing characters gain the
Villain classification.
LAY OF THE LAND ⟳ — If a character was banished in a
challenge this turn, gain 1 lore.
zh:
義警正義　所有對方角色獲得反派分類。
地形勘查　⟳ — 若本回合有角色在挑戰中被消滅，獲得 1 點傳說值。

name: Containment Unit
en:
GOT YOU NOW When you play this item, choose a
character. They can't challenge or quest while this
item is in play.
POWER SUPPLY At the start of your turn, choose and
discard a card or banish this item.
zh:
逮到你了　當你打出這個物品時，選擇一個角色。當這個物品在場時，他們不能挑戰或探險。
電力供應　在你的回合開始時，選擇並棄掉一張卡，或消滅這個物品。

name: Darkwing Tower - Icy Headquarters
en:
EVIL VANQUISHED During your turn, whenever an opposing Villain
character is banished, you may ready a character here. If you do, they
can't quest for the rest of this turn.
zh: 邪惡被消滅　在你的回合中，每當有對方反派角色被消滅時，你可以準備這裡的一個角色。若你這麼做，他們本回合剩餘時間內不能探險。

name: Tiana - Warm and Happy
en:
Support (Whenever this character quests, you may add
their ¤ to another chosen character's ¤ this turn.)
zh: 支援（每當這個角色探險時，你可以在本回合把其 ¤ 加到另一個指定角色的 ¤ 上。）

name: Grandmother Willow - Ancient Advisor
en:
SMOOTH THE WAY Once during your turn, you pay
1 ⬡ less for the next character you play this turn.
zh: 鋪平道路　你回合中一次，你本回合打出的下一個角色少支付 1 ⬡。

name: Stitch - Carefree Snowboarder
en:
BRING YOUR FRIENDS Whenever this character
quests, if you have 2 or more other characters in
play, you may draw a card.
zh: 帶上你的朋友　每當這個角色探險時，若你另有 2 個或以上的角色在場，你可以抽一張牌。

name: Tigger - Bouncing All the Way
en:
SPLENDERIFFIC BOUNCE When you play this
character, you may return chosen character,
item, or location with cost 2 or less to their
player's hand.
zh: 華麗彈跳　當你打出這個角色時，你可以將一個費用 2 或以下的指定角色、物品或地點移回其持有者的手牌。

name: Anna - Little Sister
en:
UNEXPECTED DISCOVERY When you play this
character, you may put a card from chosen
player's discard on the bottom of their deck.
zh: 意外發現　當你打出這個角色時，你可以將一張卡從指定玩家的棄牌堆放到其牌庫底。

name: Genie - Magical Researcher
en:
Boost 1 ⬡ (Once during your turn, you may pay
1 ⬡ to put the top card of your deck facedown
under this character.)
INCREASING WISDOM This character gets +1 ◊
for each card under him.
zh:
增幅 1 ⬡（你回合中一次，你可以支付 1 ⬡ 將你牌庫頂的卡牌面朝下放到這個角色下方。）
智慧增長　他下方每有一張卡，這個角色就獲得 +1 ◊。

name: Aladdin - On the Edge of Adventure
en:
QUICK ON HIS FEET Whenever you play an action,
this character gains Evasive until the start of
your next turn. (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge them.)
zh: 身手敏捷　每當你打出一個行動時，這個角色獲得迴避，直到你的下個回合開始。（只有具迴避的角色能挑戰他們。）

name: Mushu - Sneaky Dragon

SNOWY SURPRISE When you play this character,
deal 2 damage to chosen character.
zh: 雪中驚喜　當你打出這個角色時，對指定角色造成 2 點傷害。

name: Minnie Mouse - Mrs. Cratchit
en:
Ward (Opponents can't choose this character
except to challenge.)

you may put the top card of your deck facedown
under one of your characters or locations with
Boost. If you do, draw a card.
zh:
守護（對手除了挑戰外不能選擇這個角色。）
母親的愛　當你打出這個角色時，你可以將你牌庫頂的卡牌面朝下放到你一個具增幅的角色或地點下方。若你這麼做，抽一張牌。

name: Hercules - Spectral Demigod
en:
Boost 2 ⬡ (Once during your turn, you may pay
2 ⬡ to put the top card of your deck facedown
under this character.)
SUPERHUMAN STRENGTH While there's a card
under this character, he gets +3 ¤.
zh:
增幅 2 ⬡（你回合中一次，你可以支付 2 ⬡ 將你牌庫頂的卡牌面朝下放到這個角色下方。）
超人力量　當這個角色下方有卡時，他獲得 +3 ¤。

name: Elsa - Concerned Sister

CLEAR THE WAY When you play this character,
you pay 2 ⬡ less for the next location you play
this turn.
zh: 清出道路　當你打出這個角色時，你本回合打出的下一個地點少支付 2 ⬡。

name: Goofy - Klutzy Skier
en:
YAAAAAAA-HOO-HOO-HOO-HOOEY ⟳, Banish this
character — Banish chosen character.
zh: 呀啊——呼——呼——呼——伊　⟳，消滅這個角色 — 消滅指定角色。

name: Winnie the Pooh - Hungry Bear
en:
LOOKING FOR A MORSEL When you play this
character, you may return an item card from your
discard to your hand.
zh: 找點吃的　當你打出這個角色時，你可以將一張物品卡從棄牌堆移回你的手牌。

name: Jiminy Cricket - Ghost of Christmas Past
en:
Boost 2 ⬡ (Once during your turn, you may pay 2 ⬡
to put the top card of your deck facedown under this
character.)
LOOK INTO YOUR PAST Whenever you put a card
under this character, you may put a card from your
discard into your inkwell facedown and exerted.
zh:
增幅 2 ⬡（你回合中一次，你可以支付 2 ⬡ 將你牌庫頂的卡牌面朝下放到這個角色下方。）
回顧你的過去　每當你把一張卡放到這個角色下方時，你可以將一張卡從棄牌堆牌面朝下並橫置放入你的墨水池。

name: Mickey Mouse - Bob Cratchit
en:
HARD WORK Whenever this character quests, put
the top card of your deck facedown under him.
A GIVING HEART When this character is banished
in a challenge, you may put all cards that were
under him under another chosen character or
location of yours.
zh:
努力工作　每當這個角色探險時，將你牌庫頂的卡牌面朝下放到他下方。
慷慨之心　當這個角色在挑戰中被消滅時，你可以將他下方所有卡放到你另一個指定角色或地點下方。

name: Donald Duck - Along for the Ride
en:
COMIN' THROUGH! When you play this character,
you may banish chosen item.
zh: 借過！　當你打出這個角色時，你可以消滅指定的物品。

name: Judy Hopps - Snowball Patrol
en:
UNDERDOG If this is your first turn and you're
not the first player, you pay 1 ⬡ less to play this
character.
Resist +1 (Damage dealt to this character is
reduced by 1.)
zh:
居於劣勢　若這是你的第一個回合且你不是先手玩家，你打出這個角色時少支付 1 ⬡。

name: Rapunzel - Ethereal Protector
en:
Boost 2 ⬡ (Once during your turn, you may pay 2 ⬡
to put the top card of your deck facedown under this
character.)
CLONK! Whenever this character quests, if there's
a card under her, chosen opposing character can't
challenge until the start of your next turn.
zh:
增幅 2 ⬡（你回合中一次，你可以支付 2 ⬡ 將你牌庫頂的卡牌面朝下放到這個角色下方。）
鏗！　每當這個角色探險時，若她下方有卡，指定的對方角色在你的下個回合開始前不能挑戰。

name: Lilo - Rock Star

Shift 4 ⬡
I'LL COUNT YOU IN Whenever this character
quests, you may play a character with cost 2
or less from your discard for free.
zh:
變身 4 ⬡
讓我來數拍　每當這個角色探險時，你可以從你的棄牌堆免費打出一個費用 2 或以下的角色。

name: Ohana Means Family
en:
Remove all damage from chosen character of
yours. Draw a card for each 1 damage removed
this way.
zh: 移除你一個指定角色身上所有傷害。以此方式每移除 1 點傷害就抽一張牌。

name: Raging Storm
en: Banish all characters.
zh: 消滅所有角色。

name: Eeyore - In the Way
en:
THANKS FOR NOTICIN' ME For each exerted character
in play, you pay 1 ⬡ less to play this character.
SORRY ABOUT THAT When you play this character, for
each opposing player, you may choose a character of
theirs. They can't ready at the start of their next turn.
zh:
謝謝你注意到我　你在場每有一個橫置的角色，你打出這個角色時就少支付 1 ⬡。
抱歉了　當你打出這個角色時，對每位對手，你可以選擇其一個角色。他們在其下個回合開始時不能準備。

name: Anna - Soothing Sister
en:
UNUSUAL TRANSFORMATION If a card left a player's
discard this turn, this character gains Shift 0 ⬡.
WARM HEART Whenever this character quests, you
may gain lore equal to the ◊ of a character card in
your discard. If you do, put that card on the bottom
of your deck.
zh:
奇異變化　若本回合有卡離開了某位玩家的棄牌堆，這個角色獲得變身 0 ⬡。
溫暖之心　每當這個角色探險時，你可以獲得等同你棄牌堆中一張角色卡 ◊ 的傳說值。若你這麼做，將該卡放到你牌庫底。

name: Colors of the Wind
en:
Each player reveals the top card of their deck. Draw a
card for each different ink symbol on cards revealed
this way.
zh: 每位玩家展示其牌庫頂的卡。以此方式展示的卡每有一種不同的墨水符號，你就抽一張牌。

name: Mulan - Resourceful Recruit
en:
RIGOROUS TRAINING Whenever this character
quests, gain lore equal to her ¤, to a maximum of
6 lore.
zh: 嚴格訓練　每當這個角色探險時，獲得等同她 ¤ 的傳說值，最多 6 點傳說值。

name: Tod - Knows All the Tricks
en:
Shift 5 ⬡
Evasive
IMPRESSIVE LEAPS Twice during your turn,
whenever this character is chosen for an
action or an item's ability, you may ready him.
zh:
變身 5 ⬡
迴避
驚人跳躍　你回合中兩次，每當這個角色被選為行動或物品能力的目標時，你可以準備他。

name: Freeze the Vine

Banish all locations. Draw 2 cards, then choose
and discard a card.
zh: 消滅所有地點。抽兩張牌，然後選擇並棄掉一張卡。

name: Negaduck - Public Enemy Number One
en:
Shift 3 ⬡
STICKY FINGERS Whenever this character
challenges another character, each opponent
loses 1 lore and you gain 1 lore.
zh:
變身 3 ⬡
黏手指　每當這個角色挑戰另一個角色時，每位對手失去 1 點傳說值，你獲得 1 點傳說值。

name: Elsa - Ice Artisan
en:
Shift 4 ⬡
ENDLESS WINTER When you play this character and
whenever you play a location, you may exert chosen
character with 3 ¤ or less.
DISTANT CALL While this character is at a location,
she gets +3 ◊.
zh:
變身 4 ⬡
無盡寒冬　當你打出這個角色以及每當你打出一個地點時，你可以橫置一個 3 ¤ 或以下的指定角色。
遠方的呼喚　當這個角色在地點時，她獲得 +3 ◊。

name: The Cold Never Bothered Me
en:
Look at the top 4 cards of your deck. You may
reveal a location card and put it into your hand.
Put the rest into your discard. You pay 3 ⬡ less for
the next location you play this turn.
zh: 查看你牌庫頂 4 張卡。你可以展示一張地點卡並加入手牌。將其餘的放入你的棄牌堆。你本回合打出的下一個地點少支付 3 ⬡。

name: Scrooge McDuck - Reformed Ebenezer

Shift 4 ⬡
SPREADING JOY When you play this character, you

under each of your other characters. If you do,
those characters gain Ward until the start of your
next turn.
zh:
變身 4 ⬡
散播歡樂　當你打出這個角色時，你可以將你牌庫頂的卡牌面朝下放到你每個其他角色下方。若你這麼做，那些角色獲得守護，直到你的下個回合開始。

name: Belle - Snowfield Strategist
en:
WINTER STOCKPILE Whenever one of your
characters is banished, you may put that card
from your discard into your inkwell facedown
and exerted.
zh: 寒冬儲備　每當你一個角色被消滅時，你可以將該卡從棄牌堆牌面朝下並橫置放入你的墨水池。

name: Tamatoa - Seeker of Shine
en:
Boost 2 ⬡
Ward
ANYTHING THAT GLITTERS Whenever you
put a card under one of your characters or
locations, this character gets +1 ◊ this turn.

增幅 2 ⬡
守護
任何閃亮之物　每當你把一張卡放到你一個角色或地點下方時，這個角色本回合獲得 +1 ◊。

精準瞄準　你回合中一次，你可以選擇並棄掉一張卡，來對指定角色造成 2 點傷害。

Shift 5 ⬡
TAKE THAT! During your turn, whenever an item
is banished, you may pay 1 ⬡ to deal 2 damage to
chosen character.
EVILDOERS BEWARE! This character can challenge
ready Villain characters.
zh:
變身 5 ⬡
接招！　在你的回合中，每當有物品被消滅時，你可以支付 1 ⬡ 對指定角色造成 2 點傷害。
惡徒當心！　這個角色可以挑戰已準備的反派角色。

name: Let's Get Dangerous
en:
Each player shuffles their deck and then reveals
the top card. Each player who reveals a character
card may play that character for free. Otherwise,
put the revealed cards on the bottom of their
player's deck.
zh: 每位玩家洗其牌庫，然後展示牌庫頂的卡。每位展示出角色卡的玩家可以免費打出該角色；否則，將展示出的卡放到其牌庫底。

name: Pocahontas - Peacekeeper
en:
Shift 3 ⬡
CALMING WORDS When you play this character,
if you used Shift to play her and none of your
characters challenged this turn, characters can't
challenge until the start of your next turn.
zh:
變身 3 ⬡
安撫之語　當你打出這個角色時，若你以變身打出她且你本回合沒有角色挑戰過，角色在你的下個回合開始前不能挑戰。

name: Moana - Curious Explorer
en:
ANCESTRAL LEGACY You can ink cards from
your discard.
zh: 先祖傳承　你可以從你的棄牌堆將卡放入墨水池。
